code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (bg, 2)]
    if not cells:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    marker_row = next((r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 2 for v in row)), None)
    marker_col = next((c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 2 for r in range(h))), None)
    if marker_row is not None:
        line = r0 - 1 if marker_row > r1 else r1 + 1
        if 0 <= line < h:
            out[line] = [8] * w
    elif marker_col is not None:
        line = c0 - 1 if marker_col > c1 else c1 + 1
        if 0 <= line < w:
            for r in range(h):
                out[r][line] = 8
    return out
'''
